banner.service_paused: Company service is paused — synced content only
banner.sync_pending: {count} meeting texts pending sync to company server
banner.sync_error: Some content failed to sync and will be retried automatically
banner.ai_off: AI assistant is off — contact your admin

service_switch.label: Company service
service_switch.paused_hint: While paused: employees can still open pages and read already-synced content, but new sign-ins, recording syncs and edits are rejected until you re-enable.

encryption.title: Access encryption (HTTPS)
encryption.not_enabled: This instance is served over plain HTTP inside your intranet — meeting texts could be intercepted. Recommended: spend 2 minutes enabling encryption.
encryption.guide: Enablement and certificate setup follow the DevOps deployment guide (deploy/private CA bootstrap). This page only reflects status in P0.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.current_off: AI assistant is off: minutes are generated on each employee's own machine; meeting texts are never sent to any external AI service.
ai.current_on: AI assistant is on: only the domains below are reachable.
ai.egress_notice: Enabling this allows meeting texts to be sent to the endpoint above — exactly why enterprise ships zero-egress by default. The allowlist is enforced at the server network layer.

users.invite_shown_hint: Send it to your colleague. They set their own password via “Accept Invitation” on the login page. You never handle any password.
users.reset_sent: Old sessions revoked; a new invite code was issued (shown once below)
users.delete_confirm_hint: Deletes this employee's entire server-side meeting text archive (audio and voiceprints were never on the server). Type the account name {account} to confirm.

data.title: Data & backup
data.promise_line1: Backups stay only on the company's own server
data.promise_line3: Never uploaded to any external cloud
data.backup_guide: Backup and rollback are executed by the DevOps deliverables (backup-snapshot + compose two-version rollback); P0 offers no in-UI backup operations.
data.server_text_overview: The server stores finalized text only: transcript, minutes, decision flow, notes, glossary.

assistant.title: Local recording assistant
assistant.disconnected: No recording assistant on this computer yet
assistant.disconnected_hint: You can still work without it: view and edit existing meeting texts normally; only new recordings require the assistant.
assistant.download_guide: Download the recording assistant from the company server (offline package, no internet needed)

data_location.title: Where data lives
data_location.readonly_hint: Read-only: the P0 sync scope is fixed by the admin's deployment and cannot be toggled per user.
